home_sections.title: Who we are
home_sections.lead: We started with one belief: families in {{city}} should not have to travel to a big city to get good fertility care.
home_sections.text:
{{legalName}} was founded in {{city}} in {{foundedYear}} to bring specialist fertility, pregnancy and women's health care close to home. Today, couples come to us from across {{region}} for IVF, ICSI, IUI and PCOS treatment.

Consultations, ultrasound and lab tests, the fertility laboratory and pregnancy care are all in one building. That means fewer trips, faster answers and one team that knows your whole story.

We take time to explain, tell you honestly what your chances are, and never recommend treatment you don't need.

items.question: When should we see a fertility specialist?
items.answer: If you have been trying for 12 months without success — or 6 months if the woman is over 35 — it is a good time to consult. See a specialist sooner for irregular periods, PCOS, known tubal or sperm problems, or previous miscarriages.

items.question: What is Needle-Free IVF and am I eligible?
items.answer: It is an approach that reduces or replaces daily hormone injections with gentler alternatives where medically suitable. Eligibility depends on your age, reports and ovarian reserve — {{doctor.name}} will advise after evaluation.

items.question: IUI or IVF — which one do I need?
items.answer: IUI is often tried first for mild issues, with open tubes and good sperm parameters. IVF or ICSI is advised for blocked tubes, severe male-factor infertility, advanced age or after failed IUI cycles.

items.question: How many visits does an IVF cycle need?
items.answer: Typically 6–8 visits over about 4–6 weeks: consultation, monitoring scans during stimulation, egg retrieval, embryo transfer and the pregnancy test.

items.question: How much does IVF cost?
items.answer: [Add your cost policy — e.g. costs depend on the treatment plan; a transparent written estimate is shared after consultation, with EMI options available.]

items.question: Do you offer male infertility treatment?
items.answer: Yes. We offer semen analysis, counselling and treatment, including ICSI for low sperm count or poor motility.

items.question: Is my information kept confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Consultations, medical records and donor details are kept strictly private, in line with the ART (Regulation) Act and medical ethics.
